description:
Hushfeed v0.71.3 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

* With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, every room you scroll to reaches up under the clock with the shade behind it. Some rooms kept a black band there, and after the first few LIVEs the strip could go light again (#137).
* With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, Clear display in a LIVE no longer leaves a dark strip under the clock, and the top row of the side panel you open by swiping left stays below the clock (#137).
* Hide the Tako bubble now also hides the Tako bubble in the bottom right corner of feed videos, which some accounts get instead of the one above the profile button (#115).
* The Feature Gate Lab has a new Profile banner preset. It turns on Add background in TikTok's Edit profile without switching the rest of the profile to the new layout (#80).
* The collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button is dark now when TikTok is in dark mode, instead of white. Dark Favorites popup in Hushfeed settings > App turns it off (#142).

Built by GitHub Actions from commit 041c6a09cfae, with build provenance attested. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
